title.zh: 正常差异：图形不同不一定出错
title.en: Normal differences: different shapes do not necessarily mean an error

subtitle.en: Before comparing, confirm: pre-OPC or post-OPC?

body.zh: Drawn GDS；规则直角；原始图形；设计工具绘制的；原始版图（规则直角）；EXPECTED
body.en: Drawn GDS Regular right angles Original pattern Drawn by design tools Original layout (regular right angles) EXPECTED

body.zh: Boolean；Derived Mask；经过布尔运算的；派生层；合并、相交、去边缘；清理等布尔运算后；的派生图形；EXPECTED
body.en: Boolean derived mask Derived layers after Boolean operations Derived shapes after union, intersection, edge cleanup and other Boolean operations EXPECTED

body.zh: Bias；Adjustment；轮廓均匀；扩张或收缩；按工艺Bias对轮廓；进行均匀扩张或；收缩（正/负Bias）；EXPECTED
body.en: Bias adjustment Uniform contour expansion or shrinkage Apply process bias to contours for uniform expansion or shrinkage (positive/negative bias) EXPECTED

body.zh: OPC Serif /；Hammerhead；角部Serif、线端；Hammerhead等修正；OPC在角部添加Serif，；线端添加Hammerhead；等，改善印刷性；EXPECTED
body.en: OPC serif / hammerhead Corner serifs and line-end hammerhead corrections OPC adds corner serifs and line-end hammerheads to improve printability EXPECTED

body.zh: Fracture；Primitives；拆成写版；基本图元；根据Writer规则将图形；fracture为写版可识别；的基本图元；EXPECTED
body.en: Fracture primitives Split into basic mask-writing primitives Fracture shapes per writer rules into writer-recognizable basic primitives EXPECTED

body.zh: JDV；Processed Pattern；写版视图中的；处理后图形；JDV（写版数据视图）；中的最终处理后；图形；EXPECTED
body.en: JDV processed pattern Processed pattern in the mask-writing view JDV (mask-writing data view) contains the final processed pattern EXPECTED

body.zh: 数据在各阶段的变化（从Pre-OPC到Post-JDV）
body.en: Data changes by stage (pre-OPC to post-JDV)

body.zh: 比较前先对齐；数据阶段；确认同为；Pre-OPC或；Post-OPC
body.en: Align before comparing Data stage Confirm both are pre-OPC or post-OPC

body.zh: 坐标系；单位、原点、；方向一致
body.en: Coordinate system Match units, origins and orientations

body.zh: Scale；Tone；倍率/缩放 正片/负片；一致；一致
body.en: Scale Tone Match magnification/scaling and positive/negative tone Consistent Consistent

body.zh: Bias；Bias方向与；数值一致
body.en: Bias Match bias direction and value

body.zh: 判断权衡；过度要求逐点相同；会制造假警报；不同阶段图形本就会不同，；XOR大不一定有错
body.en: Judgment trade-off Demanding pointwise identity creates false alarms Shapes naturally differ across stages; a large XOR does not necessarily mean an error

body.zh: 盲目信任差异也可能；漏掉真实转换错误；转换逻辑/设置出错时，；差异可能被掩盖
body.en: Blindly trusting differences can also miss real conversion errors If conversion logic/settings are wrong, differences can be hidden

body.zh: 常见误判；把OPC当错误；OPC修改属于预期差异
body.en: Common misjudgments Treating OPC as an error OPC changes are expected differences

body.zh: 遗漏图形没发现；未对齐或阈值不当导致漏检
body.en: Missing an omitted shape Misalignment or unsuitable thresholds cause missed detection

body.zh: Pre/Post混合比较；Pre-OPC数据；Post-OPC视图；阶段不同，差异巨大
body.en: Mixed pre/post comparison Pre-OPC data Post-OPC view Different stages produce large differences

body.zh: XOR基准错误；基准层或逻辑反了
body.en: Wrong XOR reference Reference layer or logic is reversed

body.zh: 正确反馈；XOR；同阶段XOR；在同一数据阶段、同一设置下比较XOR
body.en: Correct feedback XOR Same-stage XOR Compare XOR at the same data stage and with the same settings

body.zh: 关键结构抽样；对关键结构抽样核查，结合设计意图
body.en: Sample critical structures Review sampled critical structures against design intent

body.zh: 尺寸统计；CD/线宽、间距、孔径等分布对比
body.en: Dimension statistics Compare distributions of CD/linewidth, spacing and hole diameter

body.zh: Layer数量与面积统计；Layer数、面积、密度等整体统计
body.en: Layer-count and area statistics Overall layer count, area, density and related statistics

body.zh: 边界：合理差异会随工艺节点、Mask Writer和RET策略变化。
body.en: Limit: acceptable differences vary with process node, mask writer and RET strategy
